children: Futures tracking Canadian stocks edged higher on Wednesday ahead of the Bank of Canada’s interest-rate decision.
Markets will closely watch policymakers’ comments for clues on the path ahead, with the central bank widely expected to hold it's key interest rate at 2.25% this meeting.

Canadian bond yields eased slightly after a global selloff in the previous session, as elevated oil prices and concerns over government debt in the US and other major economies pushed global yields to multi-month highs.
Employment reports from Canada and the US due later this week could further shape monetary policy expectations.

title: TSX Futures Edge Higher Ahead of BoC Decision
